name: What are the benefits of building a rental ADU?

mainEntity.name: What are the benefits of building a rental ADU?

acceptedAnswer.text: Building a rental ADU offers several benefits, including generating passive rental income, increasing property value, and providing flexible housing options. It also contributes to addressing housing shortages in areas like the East Bay. When considering this, weigh your financial goals against the responsibilities of being a landlord, as consistent income requires managing tenants and property maintenance.
acceptedAnswer.description: Benefits include rental income, increased property value, and flexible housing options, but it requires consideration of landlord responsibilities.
